The Born-Landé equation is:

\[
\Delta E_{\text{cryst}} = -\frac{N_A M z_+ z_- e^2}{4 \pi \epsilon_0 r_0} \left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right)
\]

where \(N_A = 6.022 \times 10^{23}\) mol\(^{-1}\), \(e = 1.602 \times 10^{-19}\) C, and \(\epsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-12}\) C\(^2\) / (N·m\(^2\)).

First, compute the constant \(\frac{N_A e^2}{4 \pi \epsilon_0}\):

\[
\frac{N_A e^2}{4 \pi \epsilon_0} = N_A e^2 k, \quad k = 8.99 \times 10^9 \text{ N·m}^2/\text{C}^2
\]

\[
e^2 = (1.602 \times 10^{-19})^2 = 2.566 \times 10^{-38} \text{ C}^2
\]

\[
N_A e^2 k = 6.022 \times 10^{23} \times 2.566 \times 10^{-38} \times 8.99 \times 10^9 = 1.389 \times 10^{-4} \text{ J·m/mol}
\]
